
// TestRouterStagedQueueEvictsOldest exercises overload without a live tunnel or
// sockets. Pending traffic must stay bounded and the newest batches must win.
func TestRouterStagedQueueEvictsOldest(t *testing.T) {
	d := new(Device)
	d.net.bind = &fakeBindSized{conn.IdealBatchSize}
	d.tun.device = &fakeTUNDeviceSized{conn.IdealBatchSize}
	d.PopulatePools()
	peer := &Peer{device: d}
	peer.queue.staged = make(chan *QueueOutboundElementsContainer, QueueStagedSize)
	total := 2*QueueStagedSize + 3
	for i := 0; i < total; i++ {
		elem := d.NewOutboundElement()
		elem.buffer[0] = byte(i)
		batch := d.GetOutboundElementsContainer()
		batch.elems = append(batch.elems, elem)
		peer.StagePackets(batch)
	}
	if len(peer.queue.staged) != QueueStagedSize {
		t.Fatalf("pending batches = %d, want %d", len(peer.queue.staged), QueueStagedSize)
	}
	for i := total-QueueStagedSize; i < total; i++ {
		batch := <-peer.queue.staged
		if len(batch.elems) != 1 || batch.elems[0].buffer[0] != byte(i) {
			t.Fatalf("pending batch %d was not preserved in order", i)
		}
		for _, elem := range batch.elems {
			d.PutMessageBuffer(elem.buffer)
			d.PutOutboundElement(elem)
		}
		d.PutOutboundElementsContainer(batch)
	}
	peer.FlushStagedPackets()
	if len(peer.queue.staged) != 0 { t.Fatal("staged batches remain after flush") }
}

// TestRouterResidentBatchBuffers measures the full-size buffers held by two
// socket readers and the TUN reader. It never creates a network interface.
func TestRouterResidentBatchBuffers(t *testing.T) {
	runtime.GC()
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	count := 3 * conn.IdealBatchSize
	buffers := make([]*[MaxMessageSize]byte, count)
	for i := range buffers {
		buffers[i] = new([MaxMessageSize]byte)
		for page := 0; page < MaxMessageSize; page += 4096 { buffers[i][page] = 1 }
	}
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	t.Logf("batch=%d readers=3 buffers=%d payload_bytes=%d heap_delta_bytes=%d",
		conn.IdealBatchSize, count, count*MaxMessageSize, after.HeapAlloc-before.HeapAlloc)
	runtime.KeepAlive(buffers)
}
